sentences: I measure the length of copper pipe needed between the shutoff valve and the faucet.
I cut the PVC pipe with a hacksaw and then deburr the inside edge with a pocket knife.
I apply flux to the end of the copper fitting before heating it with the propane torch.
I wrap Teflon tape clockwise around the threaded male end of the shower arm.
I tighten the compression nut on the supply line with an adjustable wrench until it stops turning.
I open the drain valve at the bottom of the water heater to flush out sediment.
I remove the P-trap under the sink to retrieve a dropped ring from the U-bend.
I insert the auger cable into the floor drain and crank the handle clockwise to break the clog.
I check the water pressure with a gauge attached to the hose bib outside the house.
I replace the flapper valve in the toilet tank and adjust the chain length to prevent leaks.
I solder the joints on the new copper water line and then wipe them with a rag.
I install a shutoff valve on the main water line so I can isolate the house later.
I run a snake through the kitchen sink drain to clear the grease blockage.
I test the sump pump by pouring water into the pit and watching the float rise.
I wrap the pipe insulation around the exposed copper line in the crawlspace to prevent freezing.
I tighten the packing nut on the stem of the outdoor faucet to stop the drip.
I measure the water flow rate by filling a bucket for one minute and weighing it.
I remove the old wax ring from the toilet base and scrape the flange clean.
I check the vent stack on the roof to ensure it is not blocked by debris.
I install a backflow preventer on the irrigation line to keep dirty water out of the supply.
